rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening in every place or situation.

example.english: It has been raining lately, so everywhere is soaking wet globally.
example.traditional: 呢排成日落雨，街上到處都濕笠笠。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 seng4 jat6 lok6 jyu5 gaai1 soeng6 dou3 cyu3 dou1 sap1 lap1 lap1

rows.note: Use this when something applies across the entire world rather than merely in every local place.

example.english: This company's services are available globally throughout the entire world.
example.traditional: 呢間公司嘅服務已經遍及全世界。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 ji5 ging1 pin3 kap6 cyun4 sai3 gaai3
